title: Widget Singles pages & seasons expansion
content:
A major feature expansion to the JeffersonWM widget system introduces standalone Singles pages and smart calendar enhancements to the Seasons directory at jeffersonwm.com/account/widget.

Key additions:

  • Singles Standalone Pages: Created a lightweight page management tab in the widget dashboard. Administrators can create and edit standalone single-page shells adapted from the clean scholarship layout, featuring editable page titles, customizable body text (lipsum), and an optional toggle to display the standard site links footer. Pages are served via clean URL rewrites (/<slug>/) derived automatically from the title.
  • Card Header Typography Polish: Card top headers now feature prominent bold card-title typography (1.1rem, 700 weight) directly on the interactive /<slug>/ ↗ link, with the redundant public URL preview field and badge removed for a cleaner card layout.
  • Smart Month-Aware Date Pickers: Upgraded the Add/Edit Season Item popup with one-click selection boxes for Mid-month (15th), End of Month (dynamically computes and displays the month's last day, e.g. 31st for Jan, 30th for Jun, 28th/29th for Feb), and Specific date (validated strictly between 1 and the actual days in that month). Changing months recalculates boundaries and updates presets automatically.
  • Expanded Seasonal Directory: Added US Government Fiscal Year Start (October 1) and End (September 30), astronomical moon phases, zodiac signs, and relative single-day holiday timing (“Tomorrow”, “Today”, “Yesterday”).
  • Scrollbar Gutter Stability: Declared scrollbar-gutter: stable; overflow-y: scroll; globally on the widget page, preventing horizontal layout shifting when navigating between tall and short tabs.
